# Konark Associates

> Leading construction company, interior designer, and real estate consultants serving Ujjain, Indore, and Barnagar in Madhya Pradesh, India.

## About

Konark Associates is a 5-star rated construction and interior design firm based in Barnagar, Madhya Pradesh. We provide end-to-end building solutions — from architectural planning and structural design to complete interior execution. With over 100 completed projects across Ujjain, Indore, and Barnagar, we are trusted for transparent pricing, premium materials, and on-time delivery.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the cost of house construction in Ujjain?**
The cost of house construction in Ujjain typically ranges from ₹1,200 to ₹2,500 per square foot, depending on the type of construction, materials used, and design complexity.

**Do you provide construction with material supply?**
Yes, we offer complete construction with material supply services. We handle everything from sourcing premium-quality cement, steel, bricks, sand, and other building materials to managing skilled labor.

**What is the cost of interior design in Ujjain?**
Interior design costs in Ujjain typically range from ₹800 to ₹2,000 per square foot, depending on the scope of work, material quality, and design complexity.

**Do you provide 3D design before starting interior work?**
Yes, we provide detailed 3D design renderings and walkthroughs before any execution begins so you can visualize your space before construction starts.

**How long does house construction take?**
A standard residential house construction typically takes 8 to 14 months, depending on the size, design complexity, and weather conditions.

**What areas do you serve?**
We serve Ujjain, Indore, Barnagar, and surrounding areas in Madhya Pradesh, India.
